projects.integration_scope: Time-based source retention: `retention.preview` lists what a policy would forget with a plan hash; `retention.apply` must echo that hash, skips sources a reviewed memory cites, forgets through certified deletion in batches with one hash-chained receipt each and blocks re-import. Unlike the upstream, every removal is receipted. Nothing runs unless requested. The Python SDK's function-calling helpers follow the upstream client: `Tools` turns the service's own MCP `tools/list` into OpenAI or Anthropic tool definitions and runs a model's tool calls through MCP `tools/call`, `Memory.prompt` builds a cited system prompt from exact excerpts, and `AsyncClient` runs SDK calls in worker threads. Independent implementation; no upstream code copied.

selected_files.inspection: process_item_flat_index (lines 202-229): session and turn retrieval keys are built from user-role turns only.

resolve_expansion (lines 17-81): user facts extracted from a session or turn join its retrieval key, either merged into the key text (`merge`: fact + ' ' + value), replacing it, or as separate keys resolving to the same id (`separate`).

projects.integration_scope: Opt-in `speaker` in retrieval.rank: a further BM25 ranking over only the lines a chosen speaker wrote (`true` keeps the user's turns; `{keep: [...]}` names up to 8 roles or participant names), fused by reciprocal rank beside the full-text arm, so evidence in assistant turns still ranks. A transcript line starts a turn at a `role:` label or, when a kept label is not a role, at a capitalised name of up to three words. Opt-in `note_keys` (context, recall and basic answers that read observer notes) keys each source passage with the observer notes whose quoted evidence overlaps it, standing in for LongMemEval's extracted user facts: `"merge"` adds the keys to the passage's lexical text (its `merge` resolution, key = value + fact). Independent implementation; no upstream code copied.
projects.not_ported: Turn-level keys, the `separate` resolution, keyphrase and session-summary key expansion, model-extracted user facts as a separate write step (observer notes stand in), the time-aware query expansion and the reading pipeline.

structural_bindings.scope: Explicit imported-call binding, lexical shadowing and JSONC alias configuration in the authorized manifest. Independent Rust implementation informed by comparison with Graphify; not full compiler or upstream application parity.

atlassian_connections.scope: Jira/Confluence Cloud protocols, attributed ADF/HTML, source dates, OAuth site selection and diagnostics; explicit copy audiences, not full ACL mirroring.

release_delivery.scope: Signed expiring manifests, rollback checks, bounded verified downloads and non-root Linux delivery. Publisher signing and public deployment require external setup.

paper_retrieval_designs.scope: After the SmartSearch paper (arXiv 2603.15599; no code published): `pack_focus` trimming, `rerank_mode: rrf` and the survival diagnostic. `pack_focus` is a retrieval default; the others are opt-in.

deletion_receipts.scope: Hash-chained receipts for memory deletion, storage pruning, graph retention and source retention, naming removed rows only by one-way hashes; `deletion.verify` re-checks each kind.

native_clustering_source.adaptation: Three explicit borrowed lifetimes added in neighboring_clusters.rs and compact_network.rs for current Rust diagnostics. Algorithms and defaults are unchanged. Application wrapper mirrors mediator RNG and parameter defaults.

native_service_runtime: Rust; SQLite and Tree-sitter native dependencies; Swift Mac launcher; browser HTML/CSS/JavaScript
